definition: The major kind (kubra) of qalqala is on a sakin qalqala letter at the end of a word. Book B ranks the degree: strongest when stopping on a geminated qalqala letter, intermediate when stopping on a non-geminated one, weakest inside a word.
limitations: Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
The detector reads an explicit sukun only; assimilation written without a sukun is not interpreted.
Internal waqf signs are not treated as stops; only verse ends and an explicit stop word are.
